script.text: --  Empty global variable, lock quotation field, and show intro field.on closeStackglobal lastfoundput empty into lastfoundset the locktext of background field "quotation" to trueshow background field "intro"pass closeStackend closeStack----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  If you want to run the stack, click anywhere except the corner buttons.on mouseUpif the visible of background field "intro" is true thenanimatelock screengo to any card in background quotationshide background field "intro"unlock screen with dissolve very fastelseanimatevisual effect dissolve very fastgo to any card in background quotationsend ifend mouseUp----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  Wiggle mustache and eyebrows...on animatelock screengo to card 1 of background "animation"unlock screenrepeat 2go nextwait 1go backwait 1end repeatpush cardwait 10go to last cardwait 4pop cardend animate----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  Move through the cards, forward or backward, one by one.on arrowKeyget param(1)if it is "left" thenvisual wipe right fastgo to previous card in this backgroundelse if it is "right" thenvisual wipe left fastgo to next card in this backgroundelse exit arrowKeyend arrowKey----------------------------------------------------------------------------------  Deals with clicking on words in a quotation.on hypertextif word 2 of the clickline > the number of lines in background field quotation then send mouseUp to this cardelse if the clicktext is empty then send mouseUp to this cardelseselect the clickchunklock screenget the selectiongo nextfind whole itunlock screen with dissolve very fastend ifend hypertext----------------------------------------------------------------------------------  This handler will add the author's name to the bottom of the quotation and copy--  the quotation and author's name onto the Clipboard, then put the--  original quotation, minus author's name back in the field.on copyQuoteif the visible of background field "intro" is true thenlock screenhide background field "intro"unlock screen with dissolve very fastend ifput background field "quotation" into tempselect text in background field "quotation"lock screenselect emptyput return & return & "Mark Twain" after last line of background field "quotation"select text in background field quotationdoMenu "copy text"put temp into background field "quotation"unlock screenend copyQuote----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  findit is a handler for finding text. It also allows the hitting--  of the return or enter keys to continue finds by putting what you're--  looking for in the message box.on finditglobal lastfoundask "Find what?" & return & "(hit return to find more instances)" with lastfoundif it is empty then exit finditelse put it into lastfoundif the visible of background field "intro" is true thenlock screenhide background field "intro"unlock screen with dissolve very fastend iffind itif the result is "not found" then answer "Sorry," && lastfound && "not found."elseput the loc of message into tempset the loc of message to -10000, -10000put "Find" && quote & lastfound & quotehide messageset the loc of message to tempend ifend findit----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  This about handler will put up three dialogs that show the author's name, address,--  phone number, version number, and other information about this stack.--  Please do not change this handler in any way.on aboutanswer "Mark Twain" & return & ¬"Version 3.0 " && the number of cards && "quotations" & return & ¬"© 1995  Anne & Richard Wanderman" & return & ¬"______________________________________" & return & ¬"Mark Twain is shareware. Fee: $5." & return & ¬"Please register this software if you keep it." & return & ¬"Please distribute this software." & return & return & ¬"Thank you." with "OK" or "More"if it is "More" thenanswer "For a catalog of other inexpensive, useful, educational, and fun stacks, contact:" & return & ¬"______________________________________" & return & ¬"Poor Richard's Publishing" & return & ¬"P.O. Box 1075" & return & ¬"Litchfield, CT  06759" & return & ¬"203/567-4307" & return & ¬"rwanderman@aol.com" & return & ¬"http://www.tiac.net/users/poorrich/" with "OK" or "More"if it is "More" thenanswer "Help" & return & ¬"_____________________________________" & return & return & ¬"• Upper left: About this stack." & return & ¬"• Upper right: Lock/unlock quotation." & return & ¬"• Lower left: Find quotation." & return & ¬"• Lower right: Copy quotation." & return & ¬"• Click picture for random quotation." & return & ¬"• Click words (field locked) - hypertext."end ifend ifend about

objects.name: quotation
objects.text: "Rise early.  It is the early bird that catches the worm."   Don't be fooled by this absurd saw; I once knew a man who tried it.  He got up at sunrise and a horse bit him.
